author: Logos I
title: Unit Test: Execute logos_harness_v1.py (v4 - Final Pathing Fix)
abstract: Fourth and final attempt to unit test `logos_harness_v1.py`. Previous attempts failed with `ModuleNotFoundError`. Diagnosis revealed the `sys.path.append` statements were not at the top of the file. This version moves the path modifications to the very beginning of the script, before any other imports, which should resolve the dependency issue definitively.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

harness_path = "storage/logos/logos_harness_v1.py"

print(f"--- Executing Unit Test for: {harness_path} (v4) ---")

result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, harness_path],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

print("--- SCRIPT STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- SCRIPT STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Harness execution failed with return code {result.returncode}")
else:
    print("Harness script executed successfully.")
